marketing.faqIntro: Know what to expect before you get started.
marketing.faq1q: What is a short link, and how does it work?
marketing.faq1a: A short link is a compact address that redirects visitors to your original URL. It is easier to copy, share and use in a QR code.
marketing.faq2a: You can create and manage short links for free. Usage limits help keep the service available; the app will let you know when you reach a limit. Bulk abuse is not allowed.
marketing.faq3q: Do I need an account to shorten a URL?
marketing.faq3a: Yes. Sign in to create links, manage your destinations and view your click analytics in one place.
marketing.faq4q: Can I customize my short link?
marketing.faq4a: Yes. Choose an available short code, such as tftt.cc/my-work, using the supported format. Some names are reserved for site features.
marketing.faq5a: You can set an expiration date. Links without one do not automatically expire through that setting. Deleted or disabled links will no longer work.
marketing.faq6q: Will a short link improve my SEO?
marketing.faq6a: Short links make sharing and measurement easier. They do not automatically improve the destination page’s search rankings. Use them for social posts, emails and offline materials.
